name: Orwell Bundle
storyline:
In Season One, Big Brother has arrived – and it’s you. Investigate the lives of citizens to find those responsible for a series of terror attacks. Information from the internet, personal communications and private files are all accessible to you. But, be warned, the information you supply will have consequences.

In Season Two, take on the role of a government official in a top-secret department of the Orwell surveillance programme during a time of political tension and violent civil unrest. Given the power to both uncover and fabricate "the truth", how far will you go in the service of your country?
summary: Get the complete Orwell experience with Season One, the award-winning surveillance thriller Orwell: Keeping an Eye on You, and the darker Season Two, Orwell: Ignorance Is Strength.
